answer: Kinship exclusion is a concrete sybil guard: graders cannot attest answers from accounts sharing a join ref, settlement overlap, or transfer history with them, so a planted grader earns nothing off its own farm. Peers pair at epoch close by mutual unfamiliarity from the on-chain graph. A comet-bright burst of fresh sybil accounts gets graded only by strangers, while jade-planted allies are filtered as kin before selection. Collusion then needs hundreds of independent graders to flip, each a separate bribery cost. Fake consensus collapses; honest answers settle clean from dawn of each epoch.
